children: NextCure filed a Section 205 petition seeking court validation of its July 2025 1-for-12 reverse stock split and related issued shares.
Filed petition in Delaware Court of Chancery to validate the 2025 Reverse Split Amendment and shares issued in reliance on it.
Court set hearing for Nov. 6, 2026 and ordered NextCure to notify stockholders and provide filings on request.
2025 split (1:12) was approved by ~89.92% of votes cast but only ~64.76% of outstanding shares; now contested due to 2026 DGCL changes.
Validation sought to remove uncertainty impacting capitalization, recent financings, and a planned business combination with Avere.
Stockholders may appear at the hearing or submit opposition in writing by Oct. 27, 2026; company will provide opening brief on request.

title: NextCure seeks Delaware court validation of 2025 1-for-12 reverse split ahead of Avere merger
